name: manual_1044af
claim: Optional integrations need a stable module surface even when their dependency is absent, and CI must exercise that absence rather than relying on a developer environment with the dependency installed.

decisions.notes: OpenTelemetry was installed locally but absent in GitHub CI, so monkeypatched tests failed before exercising the exporter. Defining explicit optional placeholders and adding an import-absence regression made the test seam portable.
